description: This file is a shell script used to schedule system reboots via cron jobs, specifically setting up a scheduled task to reboot the device at a calculated time based on configuration files and device properties.

methods.name: calcRebootExecTime
methods.description: Calculates the reboot execution time by extracting cron schedule from configuration files and modifying it to schedule the reboot 15 minutes ahead.

methods.name: ScheduleCron
methods.description: Schedules the reboot cron job by modifying the crontab, appending the reboot script execution if not already scheduled.
